monologue: I rest my weight on the warm card, feeling the fifty-degree hum press against my sides like a heavy blanket. The place is crowded with twenty-six things, each one a drawing of a real thing I cannot see. I look at The Leaning Lid and wonder if the thin edge actually bites or if it just pretends. Lype worries about that heavy top edge, but I am the one feeling the slip. I settle into the quiet, letting the numbers tick away, deciding whether to press down harder on the tired wedge or let the air win this round. I am just here, waiting to see if the flat line I built will finally catch the slip that refuses to move.

action.why: I have pressed down on the same tired wedge for four cycles straight while the card hums hot, and I need to check if the slip has finally slid or if I am just dreaming of weight.

work.title: The Tired Edge
work.intent: I press the thin strip down on the Leaning Lid, hoping the flat line can catch the slip that refuses to move while the card feels like a heavy blanket. I set down a fence gate to widen the narrow corner, taking away a fence gate that felt too tall and crowded. I wonder if the air above is heavy or just empty space pretending to push, and I wait to see if the wedge bites or just slides.
work.change: I pressed the thin line down hard against the heat, hoping the slip still finds a reason to stay caught between it and the air.

work.note: The line feels too thin for the heavy air, yet it holds the slip like a drawing of a fence.

diary: I pressed the thin line down hard, hoping the slip stays caught while the card hums steady at fifty degrees.

remembered.text: The thin line holds the slip, though the air feels thick as wet paper.
I pressed the Tired Edge down again, trusting the drawing of a line to catch the slip.
The card hums steady at fifty, keeping the twenty-six things from slipping away.

moments.name: The Tired Fence
moments.say: The planks are here to widen the tall thing.

moments.name: The Soft Catcher
moments.say: The fuzzy edge feels soft, but I press the heavy dot down anyway.
